title: Tata Kelola Data (Data Governance)
lead: Menjelaskan manajemen data, etika data, dan lisensi data. Menganalisis siklus DAMA-DMBOK: penyimpanan, backup, preservasi, berbagi. Merancang strategi manajemen data yang etis dan FAIR.

sections.label: Data Governance
sections.title: 1. Kerangka DAMA-DMBOK
body: 11 area: Data Governance, Architecture, Modeling, Storage, Security, Integration, Documents, Reference/Master Data, Warehousing/BI, Metadata, Quality. Governance adalah payung: kebijakan, peran (Data Owner, Steward, Custodian), dan audit.
sections.callout: Bahan Bacaan: DAMA-DMBOK (2017) Ch.1-3; Engelhardt et al. FAIR Handbook (2022); Eryurek et al. (2021)

sections.label: Data Governance
sections.title: 2. Etika & Lisensi
body: Etika: consent, minimisasi data, keadilan (fairness), transparansi. Lisensi data terbuka: CC0 (public domain), CC-BY (wajib atribusi), CC-BY-SA, ODbL (OpenStreetMap). Data proprietary butuh DPA/MoU. Jangan scrape situs yang melarang di ToS/robots.txt.

sections.label: Data Governance
sections.title: 3. Siklus & FAIR
body: Plan (DMP) → Collect → Assure (QA) → Describe (metadata) → Preserve (repositori, DOI) → Discover/Share → Integrate/Reuse. FAIR: Findable (PID/DOI + metadata kaya), Accessible (protokol standar + kontrol akses), Interoperable (format terbuka + kosakata standar), Reusable (lisensi jelas + provenance).
sections.callout: Istilah Kunci: DAMA-DMBOK, Data Steward, CC0/CC-BY/ODbL, DMP, FAIR
